candidates.note: The local Church directory exposes 163 detail links across four worship-body categories. One Goritsa pilgrimage is duplicated across two category pages, leaving 162 exact current worship bodies.
The local monastery directory exposes twenty exact current monastery detail pages.

source_reconciliations.note: The April 2019 Church of Greece regulation records 145 parishes and two pilgrimages. The local body directory also publishes institutional, cemetery, metropolitan, orphanage, hospital, and other worship bodies. Legal-only names without an exact current local detail page are not inferred.
The Nativity of the Theotokos pilgrimage at Goritsa has both a pilgrimage-category page and an ordinary church-category page. They are one body and are published once with both source pages.

official_parent_audit.note: The Church of Greece profile and the local official directories identify every published body under the Holy Metropolis of Demetrias and Almyros.

exclusions.note: Narrative histories mention numerous subordinate chapels and former churches. A name in historical prose is not enough to establish current operation, exact identity, or a current contact. Only separately published current detail pages are included.
Metropolis office contacts are not propagated to individual worship bodies. Only contacts printed on the body detail page or its own live site are retained.
Two legacy parish domains no longer resolve, and one legacy page path now returns not found. Their official local detail pages remain the identity and contact sources.
